# MeasureFinding { #timetoalign.timelines.flow.MeasureFinding }

```python
timelines.flow.MeasureFinding(kind, count)
```

Something a look at the measures found about their flow control.

A finding is a value handed to whoever corrects the score; nothing is
changed because of it.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name   | Type                                                              | Description                               |
|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------|
| kind   | [MeasureFindingKind](`timetoalign.core.enums.MeasureFindingKind`) | What was found.                           |
| count  | [int](`int`)                                                      | The count of the measure it was found at. |
